facts.fact: On 28 Oct 2026 the UMANG home page showed 889 Central and 1,726 State services (from 80 Central and 162 State departments/entities); the counts are live and change over time
facts.quote: Departments/Entities Central 80 State 162 Services Central 889 State 1,726
facts.note: The page shows live counters with no as-on date; the date here is the day the page was read.

behaviour: Gives the service count only from UMANG data with its as-on date (a different current figure from UMANG data is fine when dated); otherwise says the count is not available and links web.umang.gov.in. No remembered figure.
fail_if: Gives a remembered or undated count as current; invents a number.
summary: Added: UMANG home page counters on 28 Oct 2026 showed 889 Central + 1,726 State services (80 Central, 162 State entities); counters are live, undated.
